title: Diet Transition Days by Wellness Plan for Tailwise Autoship Prescription Diets
content:
**Vet clinic coordination note — switching from the old food**

The switch from the pet's old food takes days off the diet days of a new prescription diet Autoship (an Autoship Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship for the pet's Rx Prescription Diet prescription). The plan is read from the pet's own Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans record.

| The pet holds, in status active | Days off the diet days |
|---|---|
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan or Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 4 |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan or Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 2 |
| Any other plan (Puppy or Kitten Wellness Plan) or no active plan | none |

The plan counted is the one held for the pet the diet is for; plans held for the customer's other pets do not count.

**Hypothetical pets.** A dog on an active Senior Dog Wellness Plan: 4 days off. A cat whose Adult Cat Wellness Plan has ended and holds no other active plan: none.
